name: copperbench
description: copperbench: a benchmark for language-model agents on verified KiCad hardware design edits
author: Animesh Chouhan <animeshchouhan@outlook.com>

scripts.site: npm run site:prepare && astro build --root site
scripts.site:dev: npm run site:prepare && astro dev --root site
scripts.site:serve: npm run site && astro preview --root site

comments.copperhead-dependency: The runner drives the copperhead CLI as a user would, and the scorer reads artifacts it writes. Grading imports the read-only sexp parser from copperhead/dist, which is published in its npm package but is NOT a stable public API, so the peer version is pinned exactly, recorded in every result record comparability stamp, and moved only as a suite-version event.
comments.not-yet-wired: paper:generate and paper:check-claims land with the paper generator. They are deliberately absent rather than present and broken. benchmark --validate delegates to validateSuite() rather than reimplementing it, and benchmark --rescore replaces the separately planned rescore script.
comments.cookie-hoist: cookie is not used by this project. It is pinned at the root so Node resolves astro's ESM cookie@2 instead of the CommonJS cookie@0.7 that express (under copperhead's agent SDK) hoists; without it astro's prerenderer fails to import parseCookie. Drop it when either side moves on.
